integrity: An explicit proof and reproducible standalone finite-field checks are included. The scientific review is not external or independent.
scientific_limitations: Only characteristic two; finite q a power of two for point counts. Finite enumeration is limited to the stated n and q; the general proof is algebraic. Earlier graded retract classification is credited, and differently named prior full-count results remain possible.
title: Automorphism orbits and rank counts of characteristic-two square-zero-variable algebra retractions
